annotations.title: Dutch minimum wage by age: per hour, month and year, and net

description: The Dutch statutory minimum wage (wettelijk minimumloon) from 1 July 2026: the hourly rate for an age (21 and older get the full adult rate), and for a number of hours a week the gross pay per month and per year with the 8% holiday allowance (vakantiegeld), what is left after income tax, and the healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) a single person could get. Single employee without the 30% ruling or a pension contribution.

age.description: Age of the employee. Default 21 (the full adult rate applies from 21).
